BinFile.title: BinFile
BinFile.description: Represents a BIN file uploaded by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BinFile entity.

fileName.description: The name of the BIN file.

fileData.description: The data of the BIN file, stored as a base64 encoded string.

checksum.description: The checksum of the BIN file for integrity verification.

XdfFile.title: XdfFile
XdfFile.description: Represents an XDF file uploaded by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the XdfFile entity.

fileName.description: The name of the XDF file.

fileData.description: The data of the XDF file, stored as a string.

EcuMap.title: EcuMap
EcuMap.description: Represents an ECU map definition parsed from the XDF file.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EcuMap entity.

name.description: The name of the ECU map.

address.description: The memory address of the map in the BIN file.

rows.description: The number of rows in the map.

cols.description: The number of columns in the map.

dataSize.description: The size of each data element in the map (in bytes).

isBigEndian.description: Indicates if the data is stored in big-endian format.

equation.description: The equation used to convert raw data to real-world values.

xAxisDefinition.description: Definition of the X axis (e.g., load).

yAxisDefinition.description: Definition of the Y axis (e.g., RPM).

EcuMapData.title: EcuMapData
EcuMapData.description: Represents the actual data of an ECU map, read from the BIN file.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EcuMapData entity.

xAxisValues.description: The values for the X axis.

yAxisValues.description: The values for the Y axis.

mapData.description: The 2D array representing the map data.

DynoTestLog.title: DynoTestLog
DynoTestLog.description: Represents dyno test log data entered by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DynoTestLog entity.

afr.description: Air-fuel ratio measured during the test.

TunedEcuMapData.title: TunedEcuMapData
TunedEcuMapData.description: Represents the modified ECU map data after tuning.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TunedEcuMapData entity.

mapData.description: The 2D array representing the tuned map data.

correctionMapData.description: The 2D array representing percentage corrections applied to the original map data.

firestore.reasoning:
The data structure prioritizes path-based ownership for user-specific data, ensuring authorization independence and simplifying security rules. Each file type (BinFile, XdfFile) and their related data (EcuMap, EcuMapData, DynoTestLog, TunedEcuMapData) are organized under the user's document, making it easy to implement security rules based on user ID. This approach eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules, improving performance and security.

The structure supports secure `list` operations (QAPs) by segregating user data into individual user documents, preventing unauthorized access to other users' data. By using hierarchical paths, we establish clear ownership and access control for each entity. This design ensures that only the authenticated user can access their own data.
